source.name: anidoodle
source.license: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE + NOTICE vendored in resources/refs/anidoodle/). Ports re-implement rng/jitter/sample/oval geometry + pen(progress) draw-on for SVG/Remotion; no upstream canvas engine, styles, music or sound pack is used at runtime.

usage: Add scene.doodles[] in a video-engine plan: {kind, x, y, w, h, at, duration, color?, seed?, width?}. Coordinates are design px (1080 x 1920). Rendered by src/composition/doodle/Doodle.tsx inside SceneRenderer. Tag motion-spec rows with (anidoodle).

kinds.use: circle the thesis word, a sticky-note line or a prop at the spoken word; 0.45-0.7s draw-on
underline a caption keyword or note line as it is spoken; keep clear of the caption band (y < 1400)
point from cause to effect, or from a big task to its first small step
tick a finished small step in a checklist beat
cross the wrong belief / the big-name task before the reframe
draw the sticky-note / card outline itself (sketch reveal) instead of popping a finished box in
custom points[] path (thread, route, string being cut); points in design px

rules: Max 1 doodle accent per beat; it lands ON the spoken keyword (cue.at = word time), never as decoration.
Keep doodle boxes above the caption band (bottom < ~1400 design px) and clear of faces (L-033/L-038).
Brand only: stroke defaults to BRAND.accent, width 8-12, Be Vietnam Pro text stays in captions/props (rule-15).
Deterministic: fixed seed per cue (default 7); never Math.random/Date in a doodle.
